question: Which among the following festivals is thanksgiving festival, mainly celebrated in Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladainha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ladainha** is a** thanksgiving festival.**
 
• Ladainha is celebrated in the village of **Raia in South Goa**, where the locals offer **prayers and thanks** to the Lord for a** bountiful harvest.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hornbill** is a festival celebrated in** Nagaland,** which is known for its **vibrant culture and traditions**.

 
 
• It is a **week-long festival** that showcases the state's** rich cultural heritage.**
 
 
 
• **Myoko** is a** harvest festival** celebrated in the** Ziro Valley of Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
 
• During this festival, the locals **offer prayers** to the gods and goddesses for a **good harvest.**
 
 
 
• **Bihula **is a** folk festival **celebrated in Jharkhand.
 
 
• The festival is based on the** legend of Bihula, **a young woman who saved her husband from the **clutches of a snake demon**.
 
 
 
• Hence, **option 4 **is the **correct answer** as Ladainha is the thanksgiving festival mainly celebrated in Goa.
